requirement_text: The system shall document all functional and COTS-derived requirements in the Software Requirements Specification (SRS), approved by the project's Configuration Control Board prior to baseline release.
label: Meets
rationale: Requirements, including those for COTS components, are established, recorded, and formally approved as required.

requirement_text: The software requirements shall be derived from the top-level mission systems engineering requirements document.
label: Partial
rationale: Requirements analysis traces to systems engineering requirements but omits the safety/reliability analyses and hardware specifications the clause also requires as inputs.

requirement_text: Requirement changes shall be recorded in a spreadsheet maintained by the lead engineer, with no formal review or approval workflow.
label: Partial
rationale: Changes are logged, satisfying basic tracking, but the informal, unapproved process falls short of a managed change-control mechanism.

requirement_text: The system shall undergo requirements validation using operational scenarios representative of the customer's mission environment, with results reviewed by the customer representative before baseline.
label: Meets
rationale: Validation activity confirms the software will perform as intended in the customer's operational environment.

requirement_text: The software architecture document shall be produced at the completion of the design phase and made available upon request.
label: Partial
rationale: An architecture artifact exists, but the requirement does not establish a traceable transformation of requirements into that architecture.

requirement_text: The detailed design document shall describe each software unit's interfaces and algorithms sufficient for implementation and unit testing.
label: Meets
rationale: Design is recorded at a level of detail enabling coding, compiling, and testing of the described units.

requirement_text: Developers shall write source code implementing the software design approved at Critical Design Review.
label: Meets
rationale: Code implementation is explicitly tied to the approved design, satisfying the requirement.

requirement_text: All source code for the project shall be written in Python.
label: Gap
rationale: Specifying a language does not select, define, or enforce coding methods, standards, or criteria as the clause requires.

requirement_text: Static analysis shall be performed on all source code prior to release to detect defects.
label: Partial
rationale: Defect detection is covered, but security, code coverage, and complexity analysis, all minimums under this clause, are not addressed.

requirement_text: Each software unit shall be unit tested prior to integration, with test cases covering nominal and off-nominal conditions.
label: Meets
rationale: Unit-level testing is explicitly required before integration, satisfying the clause.

requirement_text: Unit tests shall be automated and re-executable via the continuous integration pipeline to ensure repeatable results.
label: Meets
rationale: Automation and re-execution directly satisfy the repeatability requirement.

requirement_text: A Version Description Document shall accompany each software release, identifying included changes, known issues, and build configuration.
label: Meets
rationale: A version description is produced for each release as required.

requirement_text: The software shall pass system-level tests before release.
label: Gap
rationale: The requirement does not tie testing to the software's specific requirements, leaving verification criteria undefined and untraceable.

requirement_text: Software builds shall be checked into the version control system before being released to the test team.
label: Meets
rationale: Items are placed under configuration management prior to testing, as required.

requirement_text: Test results shall be reviewed by the test lead and filed in the project archive.
label: Meets
rationale: Test results are evaluated and recorded, satisfying the clause.

requirement_text: Code coverage shall be measured using a coverage tool during unit testing.
label: Partial
rationale: Measurement occurs, but tracking, recording, and reporting of coverage data, also required, are not specified.

requirement_text: Code coverage percentage shall be calculated by manually estimating the proportion of code exercised, without executing automated test suites.
label: Gap
rationale: The clause requires coverage measured through analysis of actual test execution results; manual estimation without execution does not satisfy this.

requirement_text: Regression tests shall be executed after each software change to confirm previously fixed defects do not reappear.
label: Partial
rationale: Defect regression is addressed, but the requirement omits verifying that changes have not introduced a new security vulnerability.

requirement_text: All requirements associated with identified hazard mitigations shall be verified through dedicated test procedures traceable to the hazard analysis report.
label: Meets
rationale: Hazard-related requirements are verified through test with explicit traceability, as required.

requirement_text: Uplinked command tables shall be validated against expected checksums before execution on the spacecraft.
label: Partial
rationale: Checksum validation addresses data integrity but falls short of full acceptance testing of the data's effect on software and system behavior.

requirement_text: Third-party open-source libraries shall be included in the build without additional testing, since they are assumed reliable based on community usage.
label: Gap
rationale: Reused/OSS components must be tested to the same level as custom code; assuming reliability instead of testing is a direct non-compliance.

requirement_text: A cybersecurity assessment shall be conducted on all software components, including open-source and reused components, per Agency IT security policy.
label: Meets
rationale: The assessment explicitly covers COTS/OSS/reused component risk as required.

requirement_text: Cybersecurity risks for the ground software system shall be documented in the project risk register along with corresponding mitigation actions.
label: Partial
rationale: Risk identification and mitigation are documented for the ground segment, but the flight software segment required by the clause is not addressed.

requirement_text: The flight software shall implement encrypted command authentication for all uplink communications in accordance with NASA-STD-1006.
label: Meets
rationale: Unauthorized-access protection for a system with communications capability is implemented per the cited standard.

requirement_text: Cybersecurity mitigations shall be documented in the design but are not required to be tested prior to launch due to schedule constraints.
label: Gap
rationale: The clause requires mitigations to be tested and results recorded; explicitly waiving testing is a direct non-compliance.

requirement_text: Developers shall follow secure coding guidelines documented in the project's Secure Coding Standard, with adherence recorded during code review.
label: Meets
rationale: Secure coding practices are identified, recorded, and implemented as required.

requirement_text: Code reviewers shall manually check for secure coding compliance during peer review; static analysis tools are used only for style formatting.
label: Gap
rationale: The clause requires verification of secure coding compliance using static analysis tool results specifically, not manual-only review.

requirement_text: The system shall log all failed login attempts to a local file for 30 days.
label: Partial
rationale: Some adversarial-action data is collected and stored, but reporting and broader detection-data requirements are not addressed.

requirement_text: The project shall maintain a requirements traceability matrix linking each software requirement to its design element, source code module, and verification test case, updated at each baseline.
label: Meets
rationale: Bi-directional traceability across the required software elements is explicitly maintained.

requirement_text: Safety-critical flight control software shall achieve a minimum of 80 percent statement coverage during unit testing.
label: Gap
rationale: The clause mandates 100 percent MC/DC coverage for safety-critical components; statement coverage at 80 percent is a materially weaker metric and threshold.

requirement_text: All safety-critical software modules shall maintain a cyclomatic complexity of 15 or lower; any module exceeding this threshold shall be reviewed and waived with documented rationale by the technical authority.
label: Meets
rationale: The complexity threshold and waiver process match the clause exactly.

requirement_text: The project has safety-critical software components, but no specific safety-critical software process has been defined beyond standard development practices.
label: Gap
rationale: The clause requires implementing NASA-STD-8739.8 safety-critical requirements when safety-critical software exists; none have been defined.

requirement_text: The project shall develop and maintain a Software Configuration Management Plan defining CM roles, responsibilities, and authority for baseline control.
label: Meets
rationale: An SCMP addressing functions, responsibilities, and authority is explicitly required and produced.

requirement_text: Change requests shall be logged in the issue tracker; however no formal evaluation or impact analysis of proposed changes is currently performed.
label: Partial
rationale: Changes are tracked, but the clause also requires changes to be evaluated, which is explicitly absent.

requirement_text: Source code, requirements documents, test procedures, and build scripts shall be identified as configuration items and version-controlled under the project's CM repository.
label: Meets
rationale: Configuration items and their versions are identified and controlled as required.

requirement_text: Configuration audits shall be performed annually to confirm delivered software matches its baseline records.
label: Meets
rationale: Audits verify version correctness and conformance to defining records, satisfying the clause.

requirement_text: Software defects shall be tracked in the defect tracking system; defects found in supporting ground tools are handled informally via email and not entered into the tracker.
label: Partial
rationale: Non-conformance tracking exists but explicitly excludes ground tool defects, which the clause requires to be included.

requirement_text: All reported defects shall be labeled High, Medium, or Low at the discretion of the reporting engineer, with no defined criteria distinguishing the levels.
label: Gap
rationale: The clause requires clear, defined severity levels; ad hoc labeling without criteria does not meet this.

requirement_text: Software risks shall be recorded and reviewed monthly by the project risk board, with mitigation plans tracked to closure and status communicated to stakeholders.
label: Meets
rationale: Recording, analysis, tracking, control, and communication of risk are all addressed.

requirement_text: Software size and defect metrics shall be collected at each milestone for internal reference; there is no defined process for utilizing this data in decision-making or reporting it beyond the immediate team.
label: Partial
rationale: Measurements are recorded, but the clause also requires reporting and utilization, which are explicitly missing.

requirement_text: Performance metrics such as CPU utilization and memory footprint shall be monitored throughout development and compared against allocated resource budgets and functional requirements.
label: Meets
rationale: Measures are monitored to ensure performance and functionality requirements, including constraints, are met.

requirement_text: The number of requirements changes per baseline shall be tracked informally by the systems engineer but is not reported in project status metrics.
label: Partial
rationale: Volatility is tracked but not reported, while the clause requires collection, tracking, and reporting.

requirement_text: The project shall develop a Software Development Plan and Software Test Plan covering the full lifecycle; a dedicated software security plan has not been developed.
label: Gap
rationale: The clause explicitly requires security plans among the software plans; none exists.

requirement_text: Software acceptance shall be based on successful demonstration, without further specified criteria.
label: Gap
rationale: Acceptance criteria must be defined and documented; an undefined demonstration standard does not satisfy this.

requirement_text: The project schedule shall identify Preliminary Design Review, Critical Design Review, and Test Readiness Review as milestones at which software developer progress will be reviewed and audited.
label: Meets
rationale: Milestones for review and audit of developer progress are explicitly defined and documented.

requirement_text: The software developer shall deliver monthly status reports summarizing schedule progress; traceability data, change tracking information, and nonconformance records are provided only upon final delivery.
label: Partial
rationale: Periodic reporting occurs, but traceability, change tracking, and nonconformance data are withheld until final delivery rather than provided on an ongoing basis.

requirement_text: The software developer shall provide NASA with read-only PDF printouts of source code listings upon request.
label: Gap
rationale: The clause requires electronic access to source code in a modifiable format; static PDF printouts do not qualify.

requirement_text: Flight software qualification testing shall use a simulation environment that has been validated and accredited per the project's V&V plan.
label: Meets
rationale: The simulation tool used for qualification is validated and accredited as required.

requirement_text: The software test plan was baselined at project start and has not been updated despite two subsequent requirements revisions.
label: Gap
rationale: Test and verification plans must be kept consistent with current requirements; the plan was not updated after revisions.

requirement_text: Development tools such as the compiler and IDE shall be selected based on team familiarity; no formal validation or accreditation of these tools has been performed.
label: Gap
rationale: Software tools required to develop or maintain the software must be validated and accredited; none has occurred here.
